status: Prospective local design recorded before running this implementation; motivated by post-v5 review, not external preregistration
question: How do evidence retention, one-time discovery and repeated program assessment affect organizational value under fixed resource ceilings?
sensitivity_scope: All share-by-trial combinations for Discover once and Repeated discovery, cumulative memory in stationary harm and window memory in workflow reversal; fixed arms as references
additional_ablations: workflow memory only; reset program scores
do not pool procedure trial labels into workflow memory
reallocation: Actual meta-label units are deducted from the current block. All remaining whole labels are spread over the block's operational screens. Once stops paying meta costs after block 1. No borrowing across blocks.
memory: All queried screening and validation labels enter workflow sufficient statistics once when pooling is enabled. Candidate program trials use a common pre-review memory snapshot. Program validation scores are retained cumulatively or over the same eight-round window; Reset retains neither layer across rounds. Current-round observations always remain available.
program_selection: Highest mean historical trial value under the selected memory rule. Ties Biased, Balanced, Neyman. Fixed outer selector; no candidate-specific hidden probabilities.
randomness: Common keyed streams indexed by root seed, round, stage, program, trial and replicate. Root seeds differ between main analysis and sensitivity.
reporting: All cells; per-run results, paired intervals, review program shares, conditional subsequent-block outcomes, deployment selection regret, cost decomposition and all failed comparisons. New parameters will not be selected on test performance.
